why_ai: Recording performers needs a room and an engineer people choose by name, but mixing and mastering are on screens where AI tools and home studios erode the low end.
why_clarity: A good mix is judged by taste and settled over revision rounds, though approvals and spec checks give feedback within days.
why_digital: Live performances and files go in, the work happens in a DAW, and digital masters come out; tracking is bought locally, mixing increasingly remotely.

why_ai: Entirely screen-based, but artists hire a specific mixer for their ear and notes are ambiguous, which slows substitution by auto-mix tools.
why_clarity: Taste-driven deliverable with vague notes, though each revision round returns a quick verdict.
why_digital: Stems in and mixes out as files, with mixers routinely hired remotely.

why_ai: A human performance in a booth still carries most titles, but AI narration now competes directly on backlist volume.
why_clarity: The manuscript defines correctness and retailer specs are exact, while performance quality is judged by ear.
why_digital: Manuscript in, narration recorded in a booth, finished files delivered digitally, often by remote narrators.

why_ai: Publishers pay for specific narrators and directors on lead titles, a casting judgement that is relationship-driven and slow to substitute.
why_clarity: Casting and direction are taste calls whose payoff shows only in later sales and reviews.
why_digital: Recorded in studios or remote-directed booths and delivered as files; casting runs through agents and demos.

why_ai: Throughput work on modest rates is exactly where AI narration is aimed, protected only by listener preference for human voices.
why_clarity: Highly repetitive finished-hour production checked against the manuscript and an exact retailer spec.
why_digital: Home-booth recording, digital editing and online delivery to retailers, sourced remotely.

why_ai: Hands-on work at a physical lathe by a few skilled engineers whose ear decides the trade-offs, though the master arrives as a file; vinyl demand is unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: A test pressing gives a clear pass or fail, though the cutting method is part craft.
why_digital: Digital masters arrive remotely, but the cut is made by hand on a lathe and the lacquer ships to a plant.

why_ai: Fragile physical carriers need hands-on repair, baking and obsolete machines, and demand persists while tape degrades.
why_clarity: Archive standards define the deliverable and transfer steps, with QC partly by listening.
why_digital: Physical tapes and discs in, half machine-handling and half screen work, preservation files out, from vendors carriers are shipped to.

why_ai: In-room recording for a local artist who chooses a studio and engineer they trust, with home recording eroding the low end.
why_clarity: Records are judged by taste, but hours, budgets and finished songs are measurable each week.
why_digital: Bands record in a local room, work is done in the DAW and delivered digitally, and studios are chosen locally.

why_ai: A voice is personal and new state laws protect it, but synthetic voices compete hard for commercial and e-learning work.
why_clarity: Briefs are written and auditions repeat at volume, with booking outcomes as slow, sparse feedback.
why_digital: Scripts in, recorded and delivered online, cast through remote marketplaces.

why_ai: Screen work where AI mastering is already cheap and good, protected by trust in a few senior ears for label work.
why_clarity: Exact platform specs and loudness targets, with delivery checks giving immediate pass or fail.
why_digital: Mixes in, masters out, entirely online.

why_ai: Repetitive DAW editing that pitch, timing and ranking tools are steadily absorbing.
why_clarity: The same task recurs every song, judged by whether the producer and artist accept the comp.
why_digital: Takes in and edited vocals out, done remotely overnight.

why_ai: Registration and claims research is screen work, but client relationships and cross-society knowledge carry weight.
why_clarity: Registrations and claims are checkable against society statements, with payment months later.
why_digital: Repertoire data in, registrations and claims filed online with societies abroad.

why_ai: Collective management of recorded-music rights is statutory and regulated, so the societies persist even as matching and line-up research automate.
why_clarity: Distribution rules are codified and run every month or quarter, but whether money reached the right owner and performer surfaces slowly, through claims.
why_digital: Usage reports, matching and distributions are digital, while licences are still sold to local broadcasters, venues and businesses.

why_ai: A trustee-run fund with a statutory role, doing identification research that needs judgement on thin records.
why_clarity: Identifying who played on old recordings is ambiguous and errors surface only through claims.
why_digital: Session contracts, liner notes and claims in, distributions out by mail and online.

why_ai: Signing and budget decisions are high-stakes judgements, but the analysis itself is data work.
why_clarity: Whether a signing or budget was right is known only years later.
why_digital: Streaming, cost and royalty data in, internal models and reports out.

why_ai: Credits compilation is routine data work that labels' feeds and streaming services increasingly provide.
why_clarity: A credit is right or wrong, but verification depends on contributors and labels.
why_digital: Label feeds and contributions in, an online database out.

why_ai: Title acquisition analysis is screen work with some judgement on rights and narrators.
why_clarity: Title performance repeats across a catalogue, but acquisition calls are partly taste.
why_digital: Sales and listening data in, internal models out.

why_ai: Model development is itself AI work and competes with other vendors and open models.
why_clarity: Voice quality and intelligibility are measured with standard tests at scale.
why_digital: Text in, synthetic audio out through online APIs.

why_ai: Generative music competes directly with stock tracks and sound libraries.
why_clarity: Catalogue licensing repeats at huge volume, while what makes a track useful is partly taste.
why_digital: Commissioned tracks in, licences sold and delivered online worldwide.

why_ai: Fully automated processing that rival models replicate quickly.
why_clarity: Each track is processed the same way and judged quickly by the customer.
why_digital: Uploads in, processed audio out, entirely online.

why_ai: Product research is screen work, though deep workflow knowledge keeps incumbents entrenched.
why_clarity: Roadmap research is judged by adoption over release cycles.
why_digital: Telemetry and research in, software out, sold online.

why_ai: Survey and panel analysis is routine, protected by access to manufacturers' and retailers' data.
why_clarity: Recurring sizing reports follow a fixed method each year.
why_digital: Panels and surveys in, reports out digitally.

why_ai: Advocacy and standards rest on membership standing; survey compilation is routine.
why_clarity: Annual surveys follow a fixed method; standards work is consensus-driven.
why_digital: Member data and committee work in, reports and standards published.

why_ai: Physical rooms rented by the hour, with demand for rehearsal space unaffected by AI.
why_clarity: A booked, working room is an exact deliverable that repeats thousands of times.
why_digital: Physical rooms used in person, booked online with keycode access.

why_ai: Ownership research is screen work, but negotiating with rights owners runs on relationships.
why_clarity: A sample is cleared or not, but ownership research and fee negotiation vary case by case.
why_digital: Recordings and rights records in, licences negotiated by email and phone.

why_ai: Expert testimony needs an accountable person in court, and synthetic-voice claims increase demand.
why_clarity: Each case is different and the verdict comes from the court, not a test.
why_digital: Recordings in, analysis on screen, reports and testimony out, retained nationally.

why_ai: Accessible human narration is a public mission likely to persist, with review work that is routine.
why_clarity: Narration standards are written and reviews repeat title after title.
why_digital: Books in, recordings commissioned and distributed digitally to readers.

why_ai: Statutory programmes require accountable officials to certify credits.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules and audited cost reports make each certification checkable.
why_digital: Applications and cost reports in, certifications out.

why_ai: Site measurement and accountable design of real rooms, chosen by reputation.
why_clarity: Acoustic targets are measurable, but each room is a bespoke project.
why_digital: Site visits and measurements in, designs on screen, rooms built physically by others.
